title: Kid-Friendly Citrusy Mexican Mussels Tacos
description: A citrusy, molten mexican dish featuring mussels that kids will love. Serve these tacos in a bamboo tray to add a fun twist!

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.notes: adds a nice balance to lime juice

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: use a garlic press for easy mincing

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a good quality oil for best flavor

ingredients.name: corn tortillas
ingredients.notes: look for fresh ones at a mexican market or substitute with flour tortillas if needed

ingredients.name: cabbage
ingredients.notes: adds a nice crunch to the tacos

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chili flakes, cumin powder, and paprika. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lime and lemon juice. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the mussels, cover the skillet, and cook until the mussels open, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Shred the cabbage and set aside.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few mussels on each tortilla, topping with shredded cabbage and a squeeze of lime juice.
Garnish with lime wedges and a sprinkle of cumin powder, if desired.
